issues.evidence: 74HC595 VCC (pin 16) on +3V3; the board has zero capacitors (passives_count 0). Only decoupling is inside the XIAO module, several cm away.
issues.why_it_matters: Shift-register output switching (8 row drivers) without local bypass causes ground bounce / false key reads.

issues.evidence: 11x SK6812 on +5V (from XIAO 5V pin) with no bulk or per-LED capacitor.
issues.why_it_matters: SK6812 PWM current pulses (up to ~660 mA total) on an undecoupled rail from the USB 5V pin cause flicker / data corruption.

issues.evidence: Battery (JST-PH on PCB) goes directly to XIAO BAT+ pad; power switch SW35 is in the negative lead; no reverse-polarity protection.
issues.why_it_matters: Reversed LiPo destroys the XIAO charger.

acceptable_designs.reason: SK6812 are addressable LEDs with internal constant-current drivers; no series resistor needed.
D46 (1N4148W) drops the first SK6812's VDD to ~4.3 V so the 3.3 V XIAO data line meets its 0.7*VDD VIH; deliberate 'sacrificial pixel' level shift.
74HC595 ~OE tied to GND and ~SRCLR tied to +3V3 deliberately (always enabled, never cleared).
rst goes to reset button SW36; XIAO has internal reset pull-up.
LEDs powered from XIAO 5V pin which is only live on USB; intentional so RGB does not drain the battery.

notes: Ergogen-generated: schematic footprint fields empty for switches/U2/BT1 but footprints exist on the PCB (SOIC-16 for U2, JST-PH for battery) - not an electrical issue. Matrix uses 74HC595 push-pull rows with diodes to MCU columns; diode orientation prevents row-to-row shorts.
